articles.title: Two Moon Probes Will Chase Each Other in Space!
articles.summary: NASA is sending two probes to the moon to test tricky orbits where Earth and moon gravity both pull. They'll fly in formation and swap 'chaser' and 'target' jobs. Launch is set for 2027.

articles.title: You Can Detect Dark Matter from Your Backyard!
articles.summary: A DIY radio telescope made from roof flashing and a paint can can detect dark matter! By measuring hydrogen clouds' speeds, you can see the invisible stuff that makes up most of the universe. It costs under $100.

articles.title: Nature's Repeat Trick: Same Leaf Shape, Different Genes!
articles.summary: In the Galápagos, giant daisies evolved the same leaf shape multiple times—but using different genes each time! This 'parallel evolution' shows nature's creativity. Scientists studied all known species.
